scope: Known routes and documented interfaces from this review, not an exhaustive application route crawl. API-to-page associations are implementation candidates, not verified network dependencies.

routes.title: Homepage
routes.goal: Find a paper or start exploring.
changes: Keep one obvious available search action.
Move coverage detail beneath the primary task.
Show accurate availability and freshness labels.
routes.investigate: Inspect the homepage search controller, shared search components, availability state, and recent-paper query.

routes.title: Search results
routes.goal: Turn a query into a relevant paper.
changes: Rank cached exact-title matches ahead of broad matches.
Align suggestions and submitted results.
Preserve the query and disclose fallback results.
routes.investigate: Trace suggestions, submitted results, result ranking, SSE events, and fallback presentation. The /search URL was linked; its separate page was not inspected.

routes.title: Subject directory
routes.goal: Choose a field using understandable labels.
changes: Show subject name beside its code.
Explain what the count measures.
routes.investigate: Inspect taxonomy/name mapping and category directory rendering.

routes.title: Subject papers
changes: State the real sort order and visible result cap.
Keep category names consistent across views.
routes.investigate: Inspect the category query and pagination/limit contract. Mapping category pages to these API endpoints is a reuse candidate, not confirmed internal wiring.

routes.title: Paper + maps
routes.goal: Read, inspect provenance, and follow related work.
changes: Correct date meaning and citation-count scope.
Make map labels, fit, and keyboard alternatives usable.
Offer a contextual way to keep this paper.
routes.investigate: Inspect metadata ingestion/rendering, graph layout, similarity readiness, source links, and research-trail invitation.

routes.title: Author papers
routes.goal: Continue from a paper to its author.
changes: Verify author identity handling, encoded names, and result relevance before filing a new issue.
routes.investigate: Author links were observed on the paper page. Page behavior and exact matching semantics remain untested; there is no established defect here.

routes.title: Sign-in / account entry
routes.goal: Keep a private research trail and access account features.
changes: Align feature claims with real availability.
Preserve the intended return destination.
routes.investigate: Inspect login return-path handling and capability checks using an authorized test account. Never embed API keys in handoff documents.

routes.title: Account / research trail
routes.goal: Return to useful papers and obtain an account API key.
changes: Discover the actual account route and persistence behavior in the application repository.
routes.investigate: Do not invent an account URL. API docs mention the Account UI and API keys; no account session was inspected.

routes.title: Feedback
changes: Inspect the form and submission behavior before suggesting fixes.
routes.investigate: A navigation link was observed. No feedback was submitted and no defect was established.

routes.title: API documentation
routes.goal: Give developers and agents the existing integration contract.
changes: Reuse documented interfaces before inventing replacements.
Check fallback flags, readiness states, auth boundaries, and error responses in current code.
routes.investigate: Inspect docs/API.md and route definitions in the application checkout. The API page links to https://github.com/lantos1618/arxiv.gg/blob/main/docs/API.md; repository contents were not inspected in this review.

routes.title: MCP integration
routes.goal: Expose paper research tools to an external agent.
changes: Verify the tool schemas and connection in the receiving agent environment.
Use public tools first; only use account credentials in the appropriate authenticated context.
routes.investigate: Documented tools: arxiv_api_overview, arxiv_account, arxiv_search, arxiv_get_paper, arxiv_related_papers. Public tools need no login; account and Deep Search need a session cookie or API key according to the setup text.

q required; limit default 50; fuzzy=true. Account/Deep Search flows require authentication per MCP setup text. Verify endpoint-level requirements.
Response includes hasEmbedding, mapReady, generator; may queue work.
Documentation marks bulk generation retired. Do not build new workflows on this route.
Validate count scope against displayed list limits.
Total papers, downloads, queue status; not a service-availability contract unless verified.
